apps.name: Auto Mute Music
apps.short_description: Free. Keep your music on without missing a single footstep. Auto Mute Music pauses or lowers Spotify, YouTube, your browser and more the moment a fight starts, then brings it back when you die or the round ends. Works in 21 games, including Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends and Fortnite.

apps.name: FireAlpaca SE
apps.short_description: FireAlpaca SE is painting software for Windows/Mac that has evolved as a higher brand of the regular version of FireAlpaca. We provide a professional creative environment where your creativity can be visualized immediately.

apps.name: Fireworks Premier
apps.short_description: Design, customize, and preview complete fireworks shows with precision timing, music synchronization, layered effects, custom shell placement, and detailed control over every display. Build anything from short sequences to full-length coordinated shows.

apps.name: Foldaria
apps.short_description: Explorer, but faster and better. Foldaria is a modern Windows file manager: tabs, split panes, instant search, Quick Look previews, cloud sync status and 15 themes. One small app, no ads, no account, no tracking.

apps.name: GameMaker
apps.short_description: GameMaker has everything you need to take your idea from concept to finished game. With no barriers to entry and powerful functionality, GameMaker is the ultimate 2D development environment!

apps.name: Godot Engine
apps.short_description: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel.

apps.name: Irida
apps.short_description: Works like Adobe Photoshop, with on-device AI, vectors and print built in. Layers and PSD, AI generation and editing, image trace, Adobe Illustrator-ready .ai, PDF/X-4 and AI agents. One purchase, AI included. AI features require an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB VRAM or more). Everything else runs on any PC.

apps.name: JSAUX E-INK
apps.short_description: JSAUX E-Ink is a companion app for the JSAUX 5.83" E-Ink Display, bringing real-time system monitoring, time, weather, calendar, game information, and personalized images to your SteamOS setup.

apps.name: JSAUX PIXEL
apps.short_description: JSAUX PIXEL is the companion app for the JSAUX dot-matrix display, supporting the display of system status, weather, music, social media notifications, GIF animations, and personalized content.

apps.name: LaryWaves Studio
apps.short_description: Turn your music library into a visual experience. 42 real-time audio visualizers, 36 handcrafted themes, 519 pixel characters, powerful music library tools, visualize device audio, and a built-in audio engine with 10-31 Band EQ, Neural EQ and 8D Audio. No telemetry. No subscriptions. Fully offline.

apps.name: Live Wallpaper
apps.short_description: A dynamic Windows desktop app that brings your desktop to life, supporting video wallpapers, customizable mouse pointers and desktop icons, and allows sharing and downloading amazing wallpapers via the Workshop while maintaining multi-resolution, multi-monitor, and performance-friendly features.

apps.name: MobMate WhispTalk – Zero-Cloud Voice Chat Toolkit
apps.short_description: MobMate V2 is a Zero-Cloud voice chat toolkit that sends short TTS reactions like “Got it,” “I agree,” and “laugh” into your voice chat. Even late at night or when you cannot speak loudly, sending quick reactions can make VC more fun.

apps.name: My Auto Clicker
apps.short_description: My Auto Clicker is the ultimate autoclicker and game automation tool, combining a precise autoclicker, a reliable macro recorder, customizable playback binds, and the ability to browse and download community macros and themes published on the Steam Workshop—all in one clean package.

apps.name: Oasis Driver for Windows Mixed Reality
apps.short_description: A SteamVR driver for your Windows Mixed Reality VR headset on Windows 11.

apps.name: Race Track Builder
apps.short_description: Race Track Builder is a software design tool that has a simple, easy to use interface that allows you to build fantasy race tracks or use Google Maps data to create real-life terrain and roads.

apps.name: Satisfactory Modeler
apps.short_description: Model your Satisfactory builds. Set up your machines however you like, adding optional limits to the number of any of those machines and the tool will calculate how the parts will flow and how many of each machine type are getting used.

apps.name: ShareX
apps.short_description: ShareX is a free and open source program that can capture or record selected area from the screen with a single keypress, automatically save them to your hard disk/clipboard, and instantly upload them to an image/file hosting service and then can copy the URL to your clipboard.

apps.name: TransBox
apps.short_description: Modular, fully local AI interpreting for games and voice chat. In-game HUD overlay, two-way voice relay for cross-border co-op, and live captions for showcases and esports. All models run on your machine. Customize with Workshop glossaries and subtitle themes.

apps.name: Wallpaper Play
apps.short_description: 【WallpaperPlay】It is a powerful desktop beautification tool that combines dynamic wallpapers, desktop clocks, music spectrums, typing follow effects, and mouse cursors. For desktop beautification, this one is all you need! O(∩_∩)O~

apps.name: yoruneko - Living Soundscape
apps.short_description: A living ambient workspace for focus and rest. Mix your own soundscape from layered environmental audio, set a focus timer, and watch the night sky shift with the real lunar phase. Five atmospheric moods with original music, designed by a producer for long, quiet hours of work.

apps.name: 9 Kings Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

apps.name: A Game About Opening A Chest Demo
apps.short_description: Open the chest, collect legendary swords, craft powerful synergies, and amass enough gold to pay the King. Dodge the Goblin, survive the Dragon’s fire, and earn the Angel’s blessing. Can you conquer the dungeon and reach 2,000,000,000 gold coins?

apps.name: Acts of Blood Demo
apps.short_description: Acts of Blood is a third-person beat ‘em up action game about revenge that focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in the fictional city of Bandapa.

apps.name: Aleef Demo
apps.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team. Or Sell/Buy from the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+  Demo
apps.short_description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

apps.name: Another Door Demo
apps.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

apps.name: Bad House Demo
apps.short_description:
Welcome to your new home. Enjoy this free short-term rental, but there's one condition: don’t go into the basement.
Discover the first floors of the dungeon-crawling auto-battler in Bad House’s Demo!

apps.name: Barbless Demo
apps.short_description: The first chapter of Barbless. You sold everything you owned and bought a house on a tidal coast, sight unseen, to learn to fish. Here every fish is a boss fight: read the tell, answer right, and it tires. Answer wrong and your line snaps. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Barista Dream Demo
apps.short_description:
Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee.

Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

apps.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS Demo
apps.short_description: Beastopia Raiders is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Raid zombie-infested ruins, scavenge the machines humans left behind, build a refuge for your animal clan—and extract before the horde closes in.

apps.name: Beat Weaver Demo
apps.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

apps.name: Beneath Paris Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into the forbidden French Catacombs in this atmospheric first person horror experience. Explore restricted tunnels, uncover hidden secrets, and venture deeper into forgotten passages where the further you go, the more it feels like something is down there with you.

apps.name: Black Jacket Demo
apps.short_description: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

apps.name: Booster Pack Heroes Demo
apps.short_description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

apps.name: Brigador Killers Demo
apps.short_description: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

apps.name: Bulbo's Belief System Demo
apps.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

apps.name: Canvas City Demo
apps.short_description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG where movement is core to the strategy. Grind rails, launch off ramps, and use every part of the map to your advantage as you outsmart rival crews and take back the city.

apps.name: Casualties: Unknown Demo
apps.short_description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

apps.name: Causal Loop Demo
apps.short_description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler in which you solve intricate puzzles on a remote alien world by using the unique “echo” mechanic. Record, replay, and interact with past versions of yourself in this demo for Causal Loop!

apps.name: Chaos The Devil Demo
apps.short_description:
Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

apps.name: Coasteroid Demo
apps.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

apps.name: Cookiesaner Demo
apps.short_description: A Balkan bullet-heaven starring Cookie — a real apricot maltipoo. Auto-fire ćevapi, eat baklava, burek and other Balkan foods to chonk up through five belly stages, and hit STAGE 4: GOD MODE. This free demo is the full opening arc: two biomes, three showdowns to chase.

apps.name: Croak Demo
apps.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK.

apps.name: Crypt Runner Demo
apps.short_description: Navigate dangerous crypts, defeat enemies, and gather loot in this extraction dungeon crawler. If you die, you lose it all. Extract alive to bring your spoils back to your base camp. Visit NPCs, upgrade your town, and gear up for another crypt run.

apps.name: CubeMate Demo
apps.short_description: CubeMate is a chess-inspired 3D puzzle game. Rotate the cube, outthink the board, and solve hand-crafted puzzles — one move at a time.

apps.name: Deep Dish Dungeon - Demo
apps.short_description: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

apps.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening chapter of Digimon Story Time Stranger in this demo. Save data from this demo can also be transferred into the full version of the game.

apps.name: Director of Management: Football Club Demo
apps.short_description:
Choose your place in football.

Play as a First Team Manager, Club Director, Club Owner, or Federation Executive in a living football world spanning 890+ territories, 60,000+ clubs, and more than 2,000,000 players and staff.

Manage the team. Build the club. Own the institution. Govern the game.

apps.name: Drawquarium Demo
apps.short_description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

apps.name: DREADSHELL Demo
apps.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

apps.name: Drowned Lake Demo
apps.short_description: Turn on your camera and face the ██████ waters of the Drowned Lake. Play as one of three characters: fish, explore, gather resources, and follow clues to a missing documentarian. Survive found-footage horror inspired by Brazilian folklore.

apps.name: Dynamic Breach Demo
apps.short_description:
Free demo of Dynamic Breach, a top-down tactical shooter of military gothic and necro-technological
horror. Play the five operations of the prologue with an AI squad to command, plus Breach against
bots. The full campaign continues for 28 more operations across five acts.

apps.name: Family Reunion: The Appetizer (Demo)
apps.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun THE APPETIZER.

apps.name: Farm & Feast Demo
apps.short_description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

apps.name: Feed The Void Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental deckbuilder where you shape your deck the way you desire. Upgrade cards, unlock synergies, play massive combos, and constantly discover game-changing abilities.

apps.name: Fenestra Demo
apps.short_description: A fusion of semi-turn-based battles and roguelike mechanics. Build a party of heroes, explore randomly generated dungeons, discover powerful builds, and encounter strange creatures as you fight your way through the dungeon. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

apps.name: Foxy Dumplings Demo
apps.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

apps.name: Fracture Field Demo
apps.short_description: Fracture Field is an incremental quarry mining game. Shatter rocks with timed swings then invest your earnings into upgrades. Build a fleet of drones to automate your empire, bomb tough layers, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades on your journey to master the quarry.

apps.name: Game Market Mayhem Demo
apps.short_description: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

apps.name: Gasoline Demo
apps.short_description: Gasoline is ferentic & bloody --boomer shooter-- inspired by 90s classics.

apps.name: Generic Fighter Maybe Demo
apps.short_description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

apps.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator Demo
Greed & Darkness Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into a cursed fortress in this retro-style dungeon crawler where darkness is both your greatest ally and deadliest threat. Gather priceless treasure, face lovecraftian horrors and decide how much you're willing to risk before greed consumes you.

apps.name: Gunmetal Gothic Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic.  Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

apps.name: Guns 'n Goblins Demo
apps.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

apps.name: Hariti Demo
apps.short_description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

apps.name: Head Miner Demo
apps.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger! Try the free demo!

apps.name: Heliobane Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of HELIOBANE: the first three stages of World 1, from the Tharsis Belt to Admiral Husk. Build your first loadout at the Magpie, learn the Breaker, and see if the Amiga-style shoot 'em up is for you. The demo keeps its own save.

apps.name: Hellforged Demo
apps.short_description: Taste the chaos in the Hellforged Demo! Experience a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game, where every run is a tense heist. Battle demon hordes, pre-craft your build, and unleash epic synergies. Safely extract your epic gear mid-battle, or risk it all for legendary power.

apps.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Demo
apps.short_description: Join a friend in Hello Kitty Island Adventure for free! Restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more. Or play on your own in a special demo.

apps.name: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU - Demo
Heretics Amulet Demo
apps.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

apps.name: Heroll: IF Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the unknown on a mysterious board full of surprises. Roll, spin, and loop. Everything depends on the hero's luck in this dynamic journey.

apps.name: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite Demo
apps.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in the HYPERDROP demo, a hypnotising physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

apps.name: Infinity Bounce Demo
apps.short_description: Turn the galaxy into a chaotic pinball machine in this physics-based incremental game. Rack up millions of points and do your best to keep the all-consuming space cat fed. Use planets, black holes, and manipulate space and time. Can you fill the cat to the brink of a big bang?

apps.name: Inkblood Demo
apps.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

apps.name: Iron Bramble Demo
apps.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

apps.name: Iron Throat Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of Iron Throat, a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Keep the survivors of a train crash alive, scavenge the shifting tunnels inside the mountain for food and supplies, and face the first boss. Demo progress does not carry over to the full game.

apps.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles Demo
Kaido Genkai Demo
apps.short_description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

apps.name: Keikaku Demo
apps.short_description: Build your dream car and drive through the '90s. Keikaku計画 is a simulation game where you get to experience both authentic car building and life in Japan, and rise to become a '90s street legend.

apps.name: King in the Mountain Demo
apps.short_description: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

apps.name: Litany Demo
apps.short_description: Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!

apps.name: Little Sheep Valley Demo
apps.short_description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

apps.name: Little Writer Desktop Companion Demo
apps.short_description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this idle productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

apps.name: Lucky Shot Demo
apps.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

apps.name: Lunar Chrysalis Demo
apps.short_description: A box garden escape game. Su Li wakes up to find herself in an unfamiliar room, with monsters lurking around and strange symbols...she explores and solves puzzles in this eerie space, confronting the ever-approaching monsters... all to seize a glimmer of hope and escape this place!

apps.name: Mana Roots Demo
apps.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

apps.name: Mancalero Demo
apps.short_description: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

apps.name: Mecha Simultactics Alpha
apps.short_description: Mecha Simultactics is a simultaneous-turn-based competitive tactics game with customizable mechs, anime-inspired battle replays, and online multiplayer PvP.

apps.name: Mercyrail: Haven Bound Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of a railway survival management game on the real UK rail network. Choose who boards the last train out of a dead London, send crews into empty stations for supplies, and take the line north through the Home Counties. The rest of the run to Haven is in the full game.

apps.name: Metro Anomaly Demo
apps.short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

apps.name: MirrorBullet Demo
apps.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Like Perseus facing Medusa through his shield, you strike only by reflection: place mirrors, fire once, and turn the sentries' own volley into your weapon. This demo holds 24 stages from seven sectors of Greek myth.

apps.name: Moonbrella Demo
apps.short_description: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

apps.name: MOP’N SPARK Demo
apps.short_description:
Try, rewind, and rebuild!
MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

apps.name: MoteMancer Demo
apps.short_description: Automate across six Elemental planes, each with unique logistical tools. Infuse ingredients, craft alchemical structures, and uncover elegant solutions through experimentation - cultivating a garden of possibility, one discovery at a time.

apps.name: MR DONALD: DEMO
apps.short_description: MR DONALD — the game of the decade. You’re the hero, the hope of gamers and the entire world. Defeat every enemy with your partner and make gamedev great again!

apps.name: Mushroom Hunter Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

apps.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me Demo
apps.short_description: A melancholic first-person adventure through a dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Explore, encounter its strange inhabitants, and solve puzzles as you unravel a story about the fragility of existence.

apps.name: My Cuckqueen Girlfriend Demo
apps.short_description: Your girlfriend doesn't mind you sleeping with other women. In fact — she loves it. But every secret you keep, every lie you tell, brings her one step closer to something dangerous. Choose carefully!

apps.name: MYTHHUNT Demo
apps.short_description: Try MYTHHUNT solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Prepare at the lodge, explore the forest, hunt wildlife, scavenge gear, face cryptids and extract alive in this early playable preview.

apps.name: Myths are 100% True Demo
apps.short_description: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds back in 2008. This is the Demo of that game.

apps.name: No Wings Required Demo
apps.short_description: A pocket-sized adventure about a flightless duck and his trusty balloon. Explore the Featherfall Islands, take on wildly chaotic tasks, and prove that “winging it” might actually be a valid career strategy.

apps.name: Nova Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Top-down space roguelite: hold off endless hordes and build your run from cards, artifacts and weapon evolutions. This demo includes the full World 1 campaign (15 levels, 3 bosses) and Survival up to wave 20, with 4 ships and real progression.

apps.name: Nox Mortalis Demo
apps.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

apps.name: PANEMA Demo
apps.short_description: Roll, Score and Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of cartridges, challenges and Yahtzee.

apps.name: Parasite Mutant Demo
apps.short_description: This is a bio-horror RPG featuring a retro third-person semi-fixed camera and an ATC combat system that blends real-time and turn-based elements. You play as Nova, a Psionic Agent sent to investigate a mysterious abandoned city-island, ultimately uncovering the hidden truth and rewriting fate.

apps.name: Pavel Quest Demo
apps.short_description: Pavel has been captured by the diabolical mastermind Lukas. Taken to Lukas's castle on his own private island, Pavel must make his way through the trap filled castle to regain his freedom.

apps.name: Penance Demo
apps.short_description: Searching for his missing wife, Calen awakens in a place that feels both familiar and wrong. As night falls, terrifying creatures emerge. Hide, fight strategically, and solve puzzles to survive the shifting nightmare and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Plague Doctor: Apothecary Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

apps.name: POLYARIS Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the frozen Arctic in the POLYARIS demo featuring survival gameplay, skiing, boating, scavenging, dynamic weather, hostile encounters, and open-ended exploration. Stay warm, manage your needs, and survive the lonely north.

apps.name: Probably Stolen Demo
apps.short_description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

apps.name: Retro Game Collector Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Demo: play the first five in-game days. Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, hook up an old console by hand and play a built-in minigame on the CRT. The full game has 300 collectible games on 17 fictional retro systems.

apps.name: Sandcastle Demo
apps.short_description: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment. This is the demo for Sandcastle.

apps.name: Sara Demo
apps.short_description: Sara – a brutal, nonlinear visual novel about sins committed and the final chance for redemption. Are you worthy of forgiveness?

apps.name: Seed in Demo
apps.short_description: Seed in is a vibrant, 2D, puzzle game that challenges you to dig your way out of ingenious and fun levels! Along the way, you’ll enjoy a relaxing, adorable, and quirky story with memorable and lovable characters!

apps.name: Shattered Realms Demo
apps.short_description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

apps.name: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Demo

apps.name: Be a Pirate!
apps.short_description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath.  Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan.  Think, don't just click!

apps.name: Beach Side Chaos
apps.short_description: A very British seaside beat ’em up. Choose from three fighters, battle through nine stages, grab weapons and unleash powerful specials. Take back the seafront from Steve Barage and his thugs, solo or with a mate in local two-player co-op.

apps.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
apps.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

apps.name: Beer Thirty
apps.short_description: You're broke, on house arrest, and starting an illegal backyard brewery. Dig for ingredients, brew beer, sell to questionable customers, and turn your tiny operation into a beer empire. Go solo or bring 3 friends.

apps.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: Thousands of fruit lie scattered across a sunny terraced market. Pick them up, carry them to the right stall and set each one into neat, satisfying rows. No timer, no fail state: just you, 4,000+ pieces of fruit and the quiet joy of putting everything in its place.

apps.name: BioRogue
apps.short_description: Grab a living cybernetic fish. Fire it. Mutate it. BioRogue is a 3D twin-stick roguelite bullet hell where 100+ mutagens let you splice together a build that's yours alone. Die, adapt, and go again, until the regime that built this island out of genetic exploitation finally falls.

apps.name: BLIP
apps.short_description: Welcome to B.L.I.P., a semi-idle incremental game about a tiny lab with unreasonable ambitions! Build machines, recruit Scientists, and make an absurd number of Blips.

apps.name: BloodStar: Raiders
apps.short_description: Command a squad of Raiders in this brutal turn-based tactics game, fighting rivals and monsters for loot and the powerful Relic before racing to escape alive.

apps.name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand vol.5
apps.short_description:
Blue Hawaii Aniki, a self-proclaimed film director, takes a paycheck gig
hosting a cheap late-night variety show. Six segments, only four air each
episode. No lectures, no tearjerking - just 2-3 hours in a world you may
wish you lived in. New readers can start here.

apps.name: Board Game Tycoon
apps.short_description: Start your own board game publishing company! Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Have your prototypes playtested, refine your ideas and publish your games. Invite creators, win over fans and critics, and create your first hit.

apps.name: BOOM! Buster
apps.short_description: BOOM! Buster evolves the arcade genre into a fresh, new experience in this adrenaline-filled hot-potato adventure.

apps.name: Boopie Island
apps.short_description: Build a cozy colony for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises — and watch your little village grow.

apps.name: Bull Gone Wild
apps.short_description: Play as a bull where you build momentum, chain attacks, and slam into enemies as everything around you explode into chaos. It’s all about feeling powerful, out of control in a good way, and turning every fight into something loud, messy, and fun.

apps.name: Burg Battle
apps.short_description: Burg Battle is a reverse tower defense game by ElevenSeventy. Build custom bases, strategically counter your enemies, and push to destroy their castle.

apps.name: Call It a Day
apps.short_description: A physics-based online co-op game where you and your friends play as the world's worst renovation crew. Drag the couch up the stairs, water down the paint and throw the trash out the window - but don't work too hard. Cracking open a cold one with the boys is also part of the job.

apps.name: CaLLMara
apps.short_description: CallMara is a psychological thriller with elements of horror, set in a gloomy medieval village. The protagonist, waking up in the forest, discovers a devastated village and explores its secrets, gradually realizing that he has become the cause of the evil that has engulfed his village.

apps.name: Campus Clash
apps.short_description: Campus Clash is a free-to-play collectible card game set on a magical university campus. Pick one of 15 Leaders from five rival cliques, build your deck from 242 cards and outwit your opponents in turn-based duels, against the AI or in ranked online matches.

apps.name: Card Bundler: Complete Collection
apps.short_description: A short and relaxing card-collecting game. Discover, create and sell card bundles to buy new card packs and complete your collection!

apps.name: Carnival Catastrophe
apps.short_description: Clean up a trashed carnival by finding misplaced items, restocking booths, fixing up rides, and getting everything ready to open again.

apps.name: Cat Cat Cat Factory
apps.short_description: Run a factory with cats! Put them to work, optimize production, and make magic tools and medicines to fulfill requests in a fantasy world. Expand your factory, unlock new products, and venture into action stages to gather materials. Grow your factory together with your cats!

apps.name: CelSector
apps.short_description: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.

apps.name: CHEAT
apps.short_description: A co-op exam cheating game where you and up to 5 other students explore schools filled with teenage hijinks ran by a demonic faculty. Steal answers, bully nerds, pray to a magic 8 ball - develop your cheating skills all so you can pass the impossible year-end exam by any means necessary.

apps.name: Chess Twist
apps.short_description: A mind-bending chess game, where straight lines turn and diagonals fork. Millions of different boards with new strategies hidden in plain sight.

apps.name: Chrome Carnage
apps.short_description:
Machines took all jobs but one - urban blood sport.
Chrome Carnage is a multiplayer top down shooter set in vibrant chaotic cyberpunk cities.

apps.name: Chunk DAW
apps.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

apps.name: Claim Me After the Hurricane
apps.short_description: Four days after Hurricane Honora, catastrophe adjuster Arlo Fontenot arrives on powerless Corvina Key to make fast, final calls. Choose between three divergent romance routes as Vivienne, Tess, and Poppy force him to confront what he owes the island—and them.

apps.name: Click and Slash
apps.short_description: A cute desktop monster that accompanies you every day.

apps.name: Cloudwright
apps.short_description: Build a cozy factory in the clouds. Salvage your crashed airship, set conveyors humming across your island, then sail off to discover new islands and the people who live there. Solo or online co-op, up to 8 players.

apps.name: Cluckopia
apps.short_description: Cluckopia is a cozy block-building game. You are a rooster: build a house — walls, door, roof — and set out to find your missing sister. Plant, cook, forge, decorate the village and make friends at your own pace; when danger comes, awaken the legendary powers. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: Coalition Defense: The Twisted Scourge
apps.short_description: Gather heroes, warriors, and defensive towers of different races to resist the oncoming horde of mutated enemies! In this tower defense game that combines roguelite elements, kill enemies to earn coins, build defenses, and discover powerful cross-race synergies through random upgrades.

apps.name: CODEX : RECALL
apps.short_description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

apps.name: Cold Rails
apps.short_description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

apps.name: Coldwater County
apps.short_description: Build and tune your truck, then find your line across Coldwater County. Explore nine touring trails and three expert crawling routes, earn permits and medals, and tackle recovery jobs in a single-player off-road driving game.

apps.name: Coliseum Slap
apps.short_description: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.

apps.name: Color-Mixing Workshop
apps.short_description: Run your own paint workshop solo or with up to 3 friends. Brew paint from water and color tablets, mix any color you can imagine and name your discoveries. Fill customer orders, automate production with conveyor belts and grow your workshop into a color empire.

apps.name: Confined Space - Module Madness
apps.short_description: A bullet-hell roguelite where your weapons wear out. Every module burns through its own durability, and when it breaks, it's gone for good. Loot, trade and rebuild your loadout between waves, adapt to whatever the next arena throws at you, and see how long you will last in the endless battle.

apps.name: Cookiesaner
apps.short_description: Vampire Survivors, but the survivor is a real apricot maltipoo. A Balkan bullet-heaven: Cookie auto-fires ćevapi, devours baklava and burek to chonk up through five belly stages, and hits STAGE 4: GOD MODE — a giant Cookie rolling through the horde. Sevdah soundtrack. One dog. The whole čaršija.

apps.name: Counter-Strike:Global Offensive
apps.short_description:
Counter-Strike:Global Offensive (CS:GO) expands upon the team-based action gameplay that it pioneered when it was launched over 2 decades ago.

CS:GO features new maps, characters, weapons, and game modes, and delivers updated versions of the classic CS content (de_dust2, etc.).

apps.name: Crateball
apps.short_description: Crateball is a 3v3 arcade football game. Crates drop onto the pitch during the match. Some give you a gun, a homing bazooka or a shield. Others freeze you, reverse your controls or explode. The arena changes after every goal. Play online with friends, and bots take any empty spots.

apps.name: Crater Cargo: Mars
apps.short_description: Build a freight company on Mars. Connect mines, depots and spaceports, dispatch autonomous trucks, and compete for profitable contracts. Balance cargo capacity, energy costs and deadlines as you grow an industrial network on the Red Planet.

apps.name: CrazyFood
apps.short_description: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

apps.name: Creepy Mansion Party
apps.short_description: A spooky pixel-art platformer set in an abandoned mansion on Halloween night. Fight monsters, explore eerie rooms, and rescue the missing children before the Witch completes her sinister ritual.

apps.name: CTRL-U: Testing Facility
apps.short_description: CTRL-U: Testing Facility is a Platform Parkour FPS where every second counts. Fine-tune the prototype of the K-Series Auxiliary Android through a series of increasingly challenging test courses, facing obstacles and enemies that will put your speed and efficiency to the test.

apps.name: DEAD BLIND
apps.short_description: DEAD BLIND is a 2–4 player dark gambling party game where you have 60 seconds to loot an abandoned lab, then risk your haul against your friends in a winner-take-all game of Texas Hold’em. The winner takes the cash. The rest hang.

apps.name: Deadly Match
apps.short_description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

apps.name: Deep Panic
apps.short_description: An online co-op underwater horror game with up to 4 players. Pilot a submarine, explore the open ocean and descend into the depths while you fight monstrous threats and scavange its treasures.

apps.name: Den: A Short Horror Story
apps.short_description: Den is a short survival horror, where you rent a small cabin for a weekend getaway, deep inside the woods, hoping to escape reality and find joy in life.

apps.name: DET-33
apps.short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite in the ruins of new London. Take contracts from four warring factions, build a gun that breaks the game, and reach the evac before the city closes over you. 700+ weapons, interlocking build engines, and a fresh map every run.

apps.name: DIAMOND OFFICE: BASEBALL GM
apps.short_description: Become the general manager of a baseball club in this management simulation. Make decisions on player signings, trades, free-agent contracts, lineups, and team finances. Compete in a challenging league and build a legendary franchise with your own baseball philosophy.

apps.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
apps.short_description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

apps.name: DITY: Origins
apps.short_description: Autumn 1974. A cleaner from a forest parish is sent into town to buy soap. He speaks a language in which “don’t worry, I won’t help you” means yes — and the town hears no, every time. Several endings, an open world.

apps.name: Don't break the Egg
apps.short_description: Hop, dodge, kick and whatever you do, don't crack! Don't Break the Egg is a chaotic sack race game for up to 4 players where perfect timing is the difference between victory and disaster.

apps.name: Doodles Quiz Game
apps.short_description: Doodles Quiz Game is a difficult rage inducing game, your goal is to complete Doodles stupid quiz while many characters try and screw you over, will you beat Doodles Quiz, or will the characters catch you before its too later, find out in Doodles Quiz Game!

apps.name: Downfall - A Slay the Spire Fan Expansion
apps.short_description: A FREE complete expansion for Slay the Spire, made by the modding community. Features one brand new normal character, plus a new game mode with SEVEN fully complete new characters starring in a twisted campaign, and so much more.

apps.name: Draco Disease
apps.short_description: A medieval adventure-strategy game where you fight dragons and waves of zombies using fast-paced combat and flashy magic, while commanding troops to defend the kingdom.

apps.name: Dragonaute
apps.short_description: A fantasy flight action game where you are the dragon. Launch from cliffs, dive between hundreds of floating islands, race your ghost for Steam leaderboard records and set entire fleets ablaze with your fire breath, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

apps.name: DREADSHELL
apps.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

apps.name: DROPANIC
apps.short_description: Two falling-piece puzzles. One controller. Can you play both at once? Move, rotate and drop across every board together. Clear block lines and chain jewels, then take on up to four boards in this single-player puzzle challenge.

apps.name: Dugout Dice
apps.short_description:
Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy!

Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

apps.name: Dungeon Weaver
apps.short_description: Build your dungeon, create unique bosses with their own spells, and position your minions against invading adventurers!

apps.name: Dungeons of Chesslore
apps.short_description: Mastering your skills at Chess has never been easier or more fun.  Earn gold by challenging yourself in both full games of chess against 20 different NPC opponents, each with their own personalities & quirks, or in 150+ puzzles.  Take your gold and wager it online or in an intense dungeon adventure!

apps.name: Dungeum
apps.short_description: A classic top-down MMORPG of gold, caves and old wars. Hunt with friends, bring down world bosses with the whole server, fight 30-against-30 sieges, sail between islands, master a craft and make a house your own, all in one living world.

apps.name: Dust to Life
apps.short_description: Everything alive was once dust. Here you get to prove it, two ways. Be the matter and climb from a single particle all the way to life, where every stage brings a new way to play. Or be the force against it: your cursor is the weapon, and the whole tide of evolution is coming.

apps.name: DWARKA
apps.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

apps.name: Dying Hope
apps.short_description: Dying Hope is a space marine RTS centered around base building and survival. Set in a post apocalyptic future you command a cohort of humanity's remaining military personnel designated as Earth's final hope on an alien outpost planet.

apps.name: Dynamic Breach
apps.short_description: Top-down tactical shooter, military and gothic, necro-technological horror. Requiem: a solo campaign of 33 operations across 6 acts, on hand-made maps. An AI squad to command, 7 classes, 41 weapons. Onslaught: horde mode, a boss every 5 waves. All modes play against bots, offline.

apps.name: Edge of Madness
apps.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

apps.name: Empire Origin:Rise
apps.short_description: The grand strategy game "Empire Origin: Rise" is coming. Explore the traces left by human civilization on the earth, pursue the great achievements of the kings in the historical fragments, and revive the brilliant civilization in history. glory? territory? Waiting for you to dominate the world!

apps.name: Engines of Hate
apps.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

apps.name: Entropy : Zero
apps.short_description: Be the bad guy in this modification for Half-Life 2 : Episode 2 and step into the boots of a stranded Metrocop, left for dead in the abandoned City 10.

apps.name: Entropy : Zero 2
apps.short_description: Bad Cop is back. Command a small army of Combine synths and soldiers on a Northern campaign to capture Dr. Judith Mossman. A modification for Half-Life 2.

apps.name: Era of Shadows
apps.short_description:
Era of Shadows is a tower defense game, blending base building, resource management, talent progression, and exploration. Gather resources, explore and upgrade your base by day. Defend your town from an increasingly deadly waves of monsters by night. 

Can you survive the darkness?

apps.name: Evict Me Gently, Darling
apps.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set in scorching late-September Madrid. Choose Maite, Clemency, or Saara as Iker faces a viral eviction scandal, public outrage, and an irreversible route with its own crisis and ending.

apps.name: Exoplanet Settlers
apps.short_description: A turn-based 4X space strategy game built around deep logistics and open-space movement. Use cosmic geography to your advantage, disrupt enemy supply networks, custom-build your fleets, and construct interconnected planetary complexes to conquer the galaxy.

apps.name: Expedition RAVN-3
apps.short_description: Explore a punishing abandoned mine in search of your missing brother. Establish camp, manage supplies and survive as you desperately search to discover a cure for the corruption that gnaws at you in the darkness.

apps.name: Exploding Delivery Service
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op delivery game where teamwork is your only chance of survival. Guide a half-blind driver, secure unstable cargo, survive random disasters, and deliver explosive packages before everything goes horribly wrong.

apps.name: Extra Virgin Bedfellows
apps.short_description: Guide master miller Alvaro through a drought-struck olive harvest in this adult romance visual novel. Choose among three routes with Rocio, Jimena, or Nieves, and face the personal costs of debt, rivalry, secrecy, and life in a village under pressure.

apps.name: F Of X
apps.short_description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

apps.name: Fabulous Football
apps.short_description: One button. One more match. Take the pitch in fast, top-down arcade football, bend shots with aftertouch, and build a club worth coming back to. Play a quick match, settle a local rivalry, or take your squad through season after season.

apps.name: Fast Lap Racing
apps.short_description: Take street cars to the track and race against the clock. Upgrade your car's performance and set faster lap times. Chase the perfect lap and fight for positions on the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Feed Fred
apps.short_description: Grow food, smash it into bites, and make Fred absurdly fat. An active incremental game where visitors pay to watch Fred eat. Hire Friends, climb the skill tree, and turn a quiet fairground into a crowded feeding freak show.

apps.name: Fenestra
apps.short_description: A fusion of semi-turn-based battles and roguelike mechanics. Build a party of heroes, explore randomly generated dungeons, discover powerful builds, and encounter strange creatures as you fight your way through the dungeon. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

apps.name: First Steps in the NICU 2: Discharge Support Edition
apps.short_description: Join nursing student Yuka in an educational visual novel about helping babies and families move from the NICU to life at home. Explore family rounds, team conferences, and medical-care minigames across six chapters. The sequel to First Steps in the NICU, with Japanese and English text and voices.

apps.name: FIVEFOLD
apps.short_description: Build a party of five by combining jobs, skills, and sub jobs in this turn-based party-building roguelite. With no exploration or traditional level grinding, the focus is on party building and combat. Adapt your formation and skills to each enemy and develop your own strategy to overcome them.

apps.name: Fluff 'N Tumble
apps.short_description: Fluff ‘N Tumble is a one-vs-many online party game for friends who deserve each other. Tackle, hunt, or team up with your friends across a handful of cute, chaotic games. This is a collection of dynamic multiplayer party games, each one changing how one player takes on the rest of the party.

apps.name: Footy Bash
apps.short_description: Step into the world of Footy Bash,  Experience the rush of fast-paced football with 1-4 players. Unleash spectacular speckys to leave your opponents in awe and land devastating hits to thrill your fans. With dynamic gameplay and a classic look, Footy Bash is an electrifying footy spectacle.

apps.name: Fortress Forever
apps.short_description: Fortress Forever is a Source mod inspired by the earlier versions of the Team Fortress series (Team Fortress Classic and QuakeWorld Team Fortress).

apps.name: FPV Stuff
apps.short_description: An FPV drone sim for new and experienced pilots. Pick a stock drone or build your own from about a hundred parts, tune it in a Betaflight-style configurator, fly a field, a bando and a race track, and watch every flight back.

apps.name: Front Page
apps.short_description:
As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. 
What kind of Editor will you become?

apps.name: Galaxy Unwritten
apps.short_description: Pilot your own ship in a single-player space sandbox. Fight, trade, mine and salvage, then turn your earnings into a fleet and modular factories. Fine-tune your ship's loadout, board enemy vessels and create local mods with built-in visual tools.

apps.name: Gasoline
apps.short_description: Gasoline is ferentic & bloody --boomer shooter-- inspired by 90s classics.

apps.name: Gatto's Pizzeria
apps.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

apps.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
apps.short_description: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

apps.name: Gliding Together
apps.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

apps.name: Gloamfall
apps.short_description: A pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot. Descend through 7 acts and 14 biomes, topple 15 lords, roll a new arsenal every run and forge the armor you keep. Six heroes, 70 weapons and two paths to choose from after every act.

apps.name: Got More?
apps.short_description: Fight monster hordes in a bullet heaven roguelite with automatic attacks, weapon evolutions and 18 bosses. Mix guns, melee weapons and skills, unlock companions, and upgrade your gear between runs to take on the next chapter.

apps.name: GreeDrill
apps.short_description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

apps.name: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
apps.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: DownFall
apps.short_description:
DownFall is a Half-Life 2 single-player mod taking place in the White Forest surroundings.
You're once more putting on the HEV suit as Gordon Freeman. Your mission is to recover a newly developed technology by the resistance, known as the "citadel buster", before the Combine manage to destroy it.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: VR Mod
apps.short_description: Half Life 2: VR Mod is a fan-made project, which adds full Virtual Reality support to the original 2004 PC gaming classic by Valve Software. Are you ready to become the Freeman?

apps.name: Harem of Lies
apps.short_description: She's hoping you'll banish the wrong woman. How sweet. Unveil 30 adult anime characters in a single-player deduction roguelike, expose disguised succubi, and unlock their stories. Every Court can be won by reasoning alone. No forced guesses.

apps.name: Hawker
apps.short_description: HAWKER is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

apps.name: Heart Abyss
apps.short_description: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

apps.name: Helbreath Mystic Tavern Classic
apps.short_description: Rise, level up, and arm yourself for an endless war between two rival nations. Choose your allegiance and carve a path of destruction through your enemies in this reimagined and customized world of Helbreath.

apps.name: Helio-3 The Lab
apps.short_description: Helio-3, a hypnotic incremental game combining idle, merge, and physics-based gameplay. Inject, collide, split, and fuse atoms to discover new elements, earn energy, unlock powerful upgrades, and prestige your way through an evolving quantum laboratory.

apps.name: Heliobane
apps.short_description: Fly the sun-killer gunship Heliobane against a hive that eats stars, in an Amiga-style vertical shoot 'em up. Strip guns off the dead, buy the rest from a trader who calls you kiddo, and break fifteen screen-filling Heralds across three worlds.

apps.name: Hello Doctor
apps.short_description: The worst ambulance company in town is hiring. Answer the phone, rush to the patient and get them to the hospital alive: one drives, one navigates, two in the back keep them breathing. Online co-op for up to 4, real physics, rowdy patients.

apps.name: Heptic Arena
apps.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

apps.name: Hollow Card
apps.short_description: Every choice becomes a card. Every card can change the story. Explore the frozen town of Stillwater, defeat your enemies, and decide who gets to walk away. A dark narrative deckbuilder.

apps.name: HoloCozy
apps.short_description: HoloCozy is a cozy idle desktop companion where you can spend relaxing time with hololive talents in their rooms. Enjoy music and ambient sounds, keep your favorite characters close, and watch them grow at your own pace while you work, study, or unwind.

apps.name: HUNTING PIXEL
apps.short_description: Hunting Pixel is a reverse bullet-hell incremental game. Hunt swarms of pixel monsters, load them into the crusher to generate pixel resources, and level up! Unlock over a hundred combat modules and stack their powers to conquer every hunting ground!

apps.name: HypnoX: Steel Riders
apps.short_description: An arcade racing action game where you'll face challenging tracks, dangerous obstacles, and a race against time. Ride different motorcycles, fight bosses, use weapons, powerups and overcome crazy challenges.

apps.name: Icy Tower
apps.short_description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores.  How high can you get?

apps.name: Iron Maw
apps.short_description: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

apps.name: Iron Stride
apps.short_description: A top-down roguelite where you pilot a war titan through armies of thousands. Crush infantry underfoot, duel enemy titans, bolt salvaged guns and relics onto your machine and fight your way across the sector to the tyrant at the end.

apps.name: Jester's Dungeon
apps.short_description: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Relic from a wicked Jester.  Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and  use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon.

apps.name: Juicicora
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op adventure where you play a Soul, a small glossy slime. Explore a hand-painted world with up to four friends, dash and wall-jump through sky temples, mix fruit powerups at the alchemy table, and win over the villagers who live there.

apps.name: Junk Tower Together
apps.short_description: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.

apps.name: Kaiju Ace
apps.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

apps.name: Kastrava
apps.short_description: Found a kingdom and fight dozens of rival kingdoms for control of the map. Build villages, castles and walled towns, forge alliances, and break walls with trebuchets in a fast medieval strategy game where only one crown survives.

apps.name: KAYF-LIFE: Complete Edition
apps.short_description: A modification for Half-Life 2, which is a parody with an alternative look at the story and different voice acting, made in the manner of amateur Russian film dubbing that was popular in late 90's and early 2000s. It also brings visual overhaul, reworked gameplay, new mechanics and more!

apps.name: Kessrand: The Last Warden
apps.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

apps.name: KINETET
apps.short_description: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

apps.name: King Me
apps.short_description: King Me is a fast-paced medieval strategy game where every move can shift the crown. Build your forces, outsmart rivals, unleash powerful cards, and survive unpredictable events as you battle through challenging levels for glory.

apps.name: Kwun Tong: The Origin
apps.short_description: My friend is starting a new model shop located in Kwun Tong. But he disappeared since the second day of opening...

apps.name: La Sima: The Blind Beacon
apps.short_description: Train 13 skills, craft your gear, and prepare expeditions into a 100-floor chasm. A dark fantasy idle RPG where every descent asks how much you are willing to risk. Grow the town, discover creatures and relics, and seek the light of the Blind Beacon.

apps.name: Life Souls
apps.short_description: Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike for 1–6 players featuring dynamic arena combat, free-form skill combinations, epic bosses, and permanent progression.

apps.name: Litany
apps.short_description: Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!

apps.name: Little Merchant
apps.short_description: You arrive in Morvalle with empty pockets and a bag over your shoulder. Pick herbs, brew potions and haggle with the people in the square. Save up for a market stall, then a shop, then someone to mind it for you. Start small. The town is waiting.

apps.name: Loopy
apps.short_description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

apps.name: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
apps.short_description: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a chill space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

apps.name: Lucky Dice
apps.short_description: Lucky Dice is an incremental dice game. Roll dice to earn chips, collect new dice, buy upgrades and expand your table. Unlock automation to keep the dice rolling and watch your earnings grow.

apps.name: Lucky Hell
apps.short_description: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.

apps.name: Lucky Scoop
apps.short_description: Run a cozy gift shop where every scoop counts! Collect colorful gems, fulfill customer orders, solve satisfying 3D packing puzzles, upgrade your shop, and turn your little business into something special.

apps.name: Lurid Conquest
apps.short_description: Lurid Conquest is a full-featured NSFW deckbuilder with a rich story and characters. Slay the Spire–inspired gameplay is paired with a story hub where you develop relationships, corrupt your captives, and recruit them as allies to aid in your war.

apps.name: Lust and Restitution
apps.short_description: Guide museum conservator Rafe Sowerby through a six-week restitution programme in this adult romance visual novel. Choose one of three distinct routes, navigate professional and personal consequences, and pursue relationships with Yewande, Elspeth, or Blythe.

apps.name: Lyara
apps.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, Lyara tries to make sense of her surroundings while dealing with inner conflicts. Brave different challenges to find the answers she seeks as you progress through the game and grow alongside her.

apps.name: MADD: Mine Asteroids, Don't Die
apps.short_description: "Space-horror" bullet-hell with physics-controls. Maneuver your small mining & salvaging vessel through asteroids, starship wrecks, and hostile entities in the dark void of space. Find unique gadgets for your ship, and return to your hauler to upgrade and repair. Don't die.

apps.name: MagiMine Orchestra
apps.short_description: Smash ore by clicking or holding, scoop up scattered resources, and automate the mine with four specialist classes. Chain combos, flood the screen in Fever, then prestige for permanent power in this active incremental mining game.

apps.name: Mai Petite Saigon
apps.short_description: Mai-Anne aced everything she was told to. When her little brother disappears, she drops it all and dives into Paris's drawing underground to find him. A 240-page graphic novel, read page by page, with its own music and silences.

apps.name: MAID FOR YOU!
apps.short_description: Three maids. Thirty nights. One table, kept just for you. While the manager is away, Aoi, Reina and Akane open the café after hours for a single guest. Play 11 mini-games they host themselves, win them over one stage at a time, and come home to a café that remembers you. Fully voiced in Japanese.

apps.name: Mall Slop
apps.short_description: Experience the true terror that mall cops experience each day in this unique horror multiplayer game. Work with your friends to complete your tasks and end your shift before the lights turn off and the creatures begin to roam the halls.

apps.name: Mana Roots
apps.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

apps.name: Me vs. You
apps.short_description: A classic Match3 reworked into a 1v1 PVP RPG Battlegame

apps.name: Mega Squad Survivors
apps.short_description: You are the Physician. Draft 50 reimagined warriors from rival kingdoms & turn historical bonds into synergies. Start small, grow into a legion that sweeps thousands. 200+ skills, 18 bond combos, and raid bosses. A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival action roguelite. Can your legion survive?

apps.name: MEGA: City Of Titans
apps.short_description: MEGA: City of Titans blends real-time strategy, city building, and kaiju combat. Build and defend your city, command an army, and control a towering Titan to destroy rival settlements and battle other Titans in one-on-one duels. Play solo or compete in multiplayer.

apps.name: Mercyrail: Haven Bound
apps.short_description: A railway survival management game on the real UK rail network. Choose who gets a seat on the last train out of a dead London, send crews into empty towns for supplies, keep the sick alive and the engine fed, and find your own way north to Haven. Every choice on the line is remembered.

apps.name: Metro Resonance
apps.short_description: An intense 30-minute first-person survival thriller set in a post-apocalyptic underground. Survive a pitch-black tunnel, gather spare parts to fix your handcar, and reach the sealing station before your gas mask filter runs out.

apps.name: Micro Rogue
apps.short_description:
Fight, Upgrade, Repeat! 
Micro Rogue is an action roguelite where you battle room by room against enemies that upgrade just like you. Build your power, outsmart evolving foes, and see how far you can climb before either side breaks the game!

apps.name: Midnight Heat: Retro Racing
apps.short_description: Work as a private driver, train at the gym, dominate street races, build your fame to enter official tournaments, and pursue beautiful women in this retro adult racing game.

apps.name: MINES
apps.short_description: MINES* is a co-op Minesweeper game where you and your friends walk dangerous terrain armed with a stick, some flags, and questionable judgment. Probe tiles, throw stuff to trigger mines from a distance, and try not to get launched across the board. Solo or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: Mines of Mana
apps.short_description: Mines of Mana is a retro-styled, roguelike, dungeon-crawler-inspired take on the classic puzzle game Minesweeper. Navigate around unstable mana deposits as you delve deep into the mines to achieve a high score on your way to the heart of the mountain.

apps.name: Miplet Plaza
apps.short_description: Miplet Plaza is a minimalist social sanctuary for up to 8 players. No chores, no noise—just a bright, interactive world built for the joy of being together. Zip around in bumper cars, jump into minigames, or just hang out. A growing world for you and your friends.

apps.name: Mirror Drama
apps.short_description: Mirror Drama is a story-focused RPG where everyday conversations become turn-based battles. Follow Shunta as he navigates his daily life, friendships, and the mysterious reflection that haunts his past.

apps.name: MirrorBullet
apps.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Like Perseus facing Medusa through his shield, you strike only by reflection: place mirrors, fire once, and turn the sentries' own volley into your weapon. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth, every par proven minimal.

apps.name: MOGA TD
apps.short_description: Friendships are forged by beating something hard together. MOGA TD is a co-op tower defense for four: one shared board, one pool of lives, four races that cannot win alone — against four element armies, their kings and the Orc Warlord. Nobody holds the Gate alone.

apps.name: Monster Hatcher
apps.short_description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

apps.name: Moonbound
apps.short_description: A cozy chibi MMO in a hand-painted world. Pick a class, chain combos and spells, and loot armour on adventures with friends. Then settle down: own a home in town or on a housing street, furnish it your way, and gather with your guild on its estate.

apps.name: MOP’N SPARK
apps.short_description:
Try, rewind, and rebuild!
MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

apps.name: Moto 500
apps.short_description: A top-down arcade racer in the spirit of the 1977 8-bit classic.  No traditional steering, just point your analog stick in the direction you want the car to point, just like the steering controller of yore.  Lots of circuits and even multiplayer.

apps.name: Mummy's Escape
apps.short_description: After centuries of slumber, Rek awakens to find his beloved Nilo missing. Travel through ancient pyramids, oasis paths, and forgotten ruins, mastering three unique forms to overcome challenges and defeat the guardians standing in your way.

apps.name: Muscle Quest: The Swole Ones
apps.short_description: An idle RPG where muscle solves everything. Five ripped heroes who gave up on magic and swordplay smash through swarms of monsters. Enhance your gear, keep training, and push through 160 dungeons. Then take your muscles to the top of the world leaderboards.

apps.name: My Farm 2
apps.short_description: A city family inherits an abandoned farm. Cultivate your plots, raise your animals, repair and transform a run-down estate into a thriving farm. Take part in village life, face the surprises of the seasons… and uncover the mysteries hanging in the sky.

apps.name: My First Time with Hachishaku-sama
apps.short_description: During summer vacation, the protagonist visits a rural village where everyone has mysteriously vanished. There, he meets Hachishaku-sama, a towering, alluring woman. As he investigates the disappearances, he is drawn into a sweet and naughty summer with her.

apps.name: Mystic Cleaver
apps.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

apps.name: Nations Beyond Earth
apps.short_description: Lead a nation through an alternate-history space race. Build cities and industry, expand across worlds, manage trade and diplomacy, command armies and fleets, and compete for control of a living Solar System in single-player or multiplayer.

apps.name: Netherwyn
apps.short_description: Netherwyn is a challenging Roguelite Action RPG where each run sends you and your allies into lands fallen beneath a gathering shadow filled with relentless hordes and deadly boss encounters. This first release centers on Return of The Necromancer.

apps.name: Neural Defense
