apps.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

apps.name: New Eldarian
apps.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

apps.name: Night Hunt X
apps.short_description: A 3D action roguelite that fuses the chaos of massive hordes with blazing-fast Action RPG combat. Collect power cards, restructure your deck in real-time, and survive a strategic roulette of enemies in an infinite dark fantasy world.

apps.name: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
apps.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

apps.name: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
apps.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

apps.name: Nocta
apps.short_description: "Before the beginning, Time and Nothingness danced..." Become Nocta, the Embodiment of Time, and safeguard Creation from the abyssal hands of the Void in an original cosmic creation myth. Hand-drawn stained-glass art by 花凛. Wishlist now!

apps.name: Not My Dad
apps.short_description:
Something is stealing people's skin. And your dad might be one of the victims...
In Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game, complete your daily tasks while trying to live with the disturbing presence of "DAD".

apps.name: Null Signal
apps.short_description: The machines won. You wake in a forsaken world where you must scavenge, build and explore to survive on your own or with friends. As nature encroaches due to humanity's absence, will you ally with it or use the technology that destroyed us to empower yourself?

apps.name: One Bard Move
apps.short_description: One Bard Move is a comedic 3D precision platformer where every jump can become a disaster. Master increasingly demanding movement, survive absurd oversized obstacles, and endure a narrator who always has something to say about your failures.

apps.name: One Last Dance Please!
apps.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

apps.name: Only Sheep
apps.short_description: Start as one hungry sheep. Eat visible trails through lush pastures, earn upgrades and grow a huge working flock with mowers. Expand your grazing business, hunt for treasures and get home before the wolf takes this outing’s earnings. A single-player incremental adventure, playable offline.

apps.name: Orendral: After the Sundering
apps.short_description: A single-player, offline MUD-style text RPG. Learn a class, explore rival cities and dangerous roads, solve quests, and recruit simulated adventurers for party raids. Play through a classic desktop client with aliases, hotkeys, and a searchable manual. Intentionally silent.

apps.name: Orion's Reach
apps.short_description: A sci-fi match-3 adventure where every move carries the story forward. Break through blockers, chain cascades and master chapter-specific puzzles across 440 levels. Follow an unlikely crew, chase a new high score in Infinite, or challenge rivals in online Versus.

apps.name: Overdepth
apps.short_description: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.

apps.name: Overdrive: New Earth
apps.short_description: OVERDRIVE is a retro 3D combat racing ARPG. Tracks thwart you at every turn. Rivals punish your mistakes. Build and arm your car, conquer five scarred biomes, and survive a world that fights back at every turn.

apps.name: P.A.W.S
apps.short_description:
P.A.W.S. is a fast-paced co-op tower defense where you and your fellow engineers join forces to build, improvise, and keep the workshop safe from the Warped.

Craft your defenses, keep the machines running, and work together when things inevitably go wrong.

apps.name: PackBound
apps.short_description: A backpack auto-battler with PvP and roguelike Co-op where every hero packs differently. Bottle poisons, stitch voodoo covens, cram plushies into jars, then watch your bag fight. Beat rivals in PvP to steal their stickers, or team up for 3-player boss fights.

apps.name: Padel Simulator
apps.short_description: Step onto the court in Padel Simulator, a third-person sports game focused on responsive movement, precise racket control, smart AI, and dynamic ball physics. Team up with an AI partner, use the walls, and fight for every point in authentic 2v2 padel matches.

apps.name: Parasite: Among the Guests
apps.short_description: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.

apps.name: Paresis® II
apps.short_description:
Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses.
Survive…if you can.

apps.name: Path to Power
apps.short_description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

apps.name: Pavel Quest
apps.short_description: Pavel has been captured by the diabolical mastermind Lukas. Taken to Lukas's castle on his own private island, Pavel must make his way through the trap filled castle to regain his freedom.

apps.name: Petri Party
apps.short_description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

apps.name: Pirates Life
apps.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

apps.name: Plague Doctor: Apothecary
apps.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

apps.name: Plastic Noodles: Connector
apps.short_description:
Cursed and stuck in a time loop, reach one of the almost 30 different endings. Meet the wacky companions and adversaries that help or hinder your quest. Create powerful builds and dodge/parry bullets while managing the little time you have per loop. 

Can you reach your happily ever after?

apps.name: Portal Stories: VR
apps.short_description:
Portal Stories: VR builds on the foundations of the award winning Portal 2 modification .

Portal Stories: VR has a brand new mini story set in the Portal Universe. It features 10 brand new puzzles, specifically designed  to work using the 360 degrees room scale that SteamVR offers. Inside Aperture, you'll be able to use the new "Aperture Science Instant Teleportation Device" and the "Aperture Science Apparatus Retrieval Tool" to solve the new tests. 

Powered by Unreal Engine 4, Portal Stories: VR gives the Aperture Science facility a whole fresh look. With new models, textures, particles and more!

Portal Stories: VR will be available early April for Free on Steam.
An HTC Vive Headset is required in order to play.

apps.name: Portal: Alive & Kicking
apps.short_description: Portal: Alive & Kicking is a full remake and re-imagining of Valve's award-winning title, Portal. Using the visual capabilities of Portal 2, A&K slips you back into the cold test chambers of Aperture Science to retell the original story of Chell and GLaDOS.

apps.name: Portal: Revolution
apps.short_description: The Portal Mod you've been waiting for. Delve into a new story with original characters, spanning over 8 hours of gameplay and featuring over 40 new challenging test chambers which make use of new mechanics.

apps.name: Possessed Kingdom
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Play cards to balance your economy, defenses and army. Read the enemy, draw your army’s route, and choose when to strike.

apps.name: Potion Pantry
apps.short_description: Restore a mysterious magical pantry through handcrafted logic puzzles. Follow the previous Keeper's notes, uncover what happened to them, and decide what it means when the pantry welcomes you home.

apps.name: Prigod Idle
apps.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

apps.name: Project Android
apps.short_description: Project Android, the solution to tomorrow's problems. Perform various experiments and raise the android Femme into humanity's savior.

apps.name: PROJECT Ω / MEG
apps.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

apps.name: Pumpkin Reaper
apps.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is an action roguelike where skill placement shapes your build. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to trigger synergies and awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

apps.name: RavenStar
apps.short_description: RavenStar is a mini-metroidvania where making friends unlocks new abilities! Discover hidden secrets, traverse an interconnected world, and cultivate friendships with a charming cast of characters in this heartfelt platformer.

apps.name: REACTIONESE
apps.short_description: REACTIONESE is a fast-paced online multiplayer party game for up to 6 players. Challenge your friends in 17 unique minigames that test your reflexes, timing, knowledge, and quick thinking. React fast, earn points, and prove you're the ultimate champion!

apps.name: Record Studio Tycoon
apps.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

apps.name: Red Veil
apps.short_description: A knight sealed in a wall for centuries wakes rebuilt in chrome, under a city that hasn't seen the sun in 31 years. Parry, break and bite your way through tense one-on-one sword duels in a blood-red, two-colour cyberpunk night.

apps.name: Regentie
apps.short_description: Take your seat at a strange low-poly table where four kings wage a real-time strategy war on the board in front of you, while the room around you melts, the sky falls and a mole sells you crates from under the floor. A surreal board-game RTS full of secrets.

apps.name: Rejoin Me After Brexit
apps.short_description: An adult romance visual novel about Owen Pascoe, a struggling English coach operator sent across the Channel on a civic errand. Choose one of three distinct routes as a herring fair, a hungry local paper, and two watchful towns turn private romance into public news.

apps.name: Relic Radar
apps.short_description: Turn browsing Steam into a treasure hunt. Scan game pages, collect fragments, and dig up relics to complete your collection. Discover rare Grumlz, choose a buddy to help with excavations, and collect tradable Steam inventory items.

apps.name: Restore the Luminous
apps.short_description: 1対1で戦う対戦カードゲームです。どのリーダーを選んでも使えるカードは同じなのに、リーダーによって固有の能力も、最初の手札の枚数も、場に出せるユニットの数も変わります。全カードが最初から使えて、ガチャはありません。

apps.name: Retro Game Collector Simulator
apps.short_description: Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, and bring old consoles back to life. Collect 300 games across 17 fictional retro systems, connect them to a CRT, play built-in minigames, and turn a cluttered basement into your own collection.

apps.name: RoadHouse Manager
apps.short_description: A rowdy roadhouse roguelite! Serve thirsty strangers, flair-bartend cocktails for big mult bonus combos, and throw down when trouble erupts. Every goon you shirk or smash can be molded by a reactive villain into your ARCH-NEMESIS. Chase love, rare booze, secrets, decor, and upgrades to survive!

apps.name: ROLL FOR THE CROWN
apps.short_description: Roll through six themed racing regions, manage your ranch, train promising horses, and invest in facilities before putting every decision to the test on the track. A single-player strategy game combining board-game route planning with horse-racing management.

apps.name: Ruff Day
apps.short_description: Owners drop off their pups in the morning with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, walking, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

apps.name: Rug Restorer Simulator
apps.short_description: Bring tired rugs back to life in a cozy first-person restoration sim. Wash away grime, repair worn fibers, and run your own workshop beside a Polish neighborhood bazaar. Take on new jobs, upgrade your tools, and make the space your own.

apps.name: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
apps.short_description: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

apps.name: Rune Force
apps.short_description: Rune Force is a fast-paced survival roguelike where you place and merge elemental runes to defend your Core. Fight through escalating waves, defeat deadly bosses, discover and use relics, charms, and build defining level ups. Forge permanent upgrades, master each element, and save the Rune Force.

apps.name: Rustbrook
apps.short_description: Build your own car piece by piece, tighten every bolt, work different jobs, earn money, find a place to live, and take care of your daily needs in a life simulator with a full day and night cycle.

apps.name: Rustlers Online
apps.short_description: Sheriff or outlaw: your call. RUSTLERS is an online third-person Wild West arena shooter with tight 8-player showdowns, six modes from one-round duels to the Wanted manhunt, 20+ period firearms, eleven frontier arenas and 67 ranks to earn.

apps.name: SAFE INSIDE
apps.short_description: Stay close together and use teamwork to fight through hordes of infected and other mutated freaks while navigating between saferooms.

apps.name: SAGE
apps.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to learn spells and become a friend of the forest.

apps.name: SAILORSIM
apps.short_description: Sail and motor across the Mediterranean, from Salou to Mallorca and Menorca. Berth, anchor in the coves, race a triangle course, cross to the Balearics by day or night and ride out a tramontane gale. Free, no ads.

apps.name: Sanarah
apps.short_description:
Sanarah: Episode One

Evade, shoot and outsmart machine counterparts and spectral aberrations. Hack your way though the physical, digital and spiritual plains. Dig deeper though time evolving your three bodies while uncovering the mystery of Leelee.

apps.name: SANDSTRIKE
apps.short_description: Top-down robot shooter for a world that ran out of humans. Shoot robots apart limb by limb in PvP, co-op and bot matches; rebuild from scrap, gear up with gadgets and implants, repeat. Peer-to-peer over Steam: no servers to switch off.

apps.name: Sanitarium of the Void
apps.short_description: Run a Victorian sanitarium on a remote island. Treat patients, expand your grounds, explore the caves below, and decide whether to save lives or offer them to the Old Ones. Your choices shape the asylum's fate.

apps.name: Sara The Sexy Thief Censored!
apps.short_description: Single Player Action Third-Person Shooter Game Featuring Sexy Female Protagonist

apps.name: Scrapline
apps.short_description: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

apps.name: Secrets of Suburbia
apps.short_description: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997. Spend the night exploring the early internet and following a digital trail in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

apps.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
apps.short_description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

apps.name: Shaman
apps.short_description: Nothing Lost is a generational action-roguelike where every death strengthens your next hero. Battle through ever-shifting dungeons, absorb the powers of your fallen heroes, and combine their abilities to conquer the Tower of Souls.

apps.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
apps.short_description: Your new best friend Sendy is here to guide you through 90+ handcrafted physics puzzles. Solve them, then make your own levels, and maybe keep an eye on him while you're at it.

apps.name: Shitty Shift: Toilet Sim
apps.short_description: Even a public toilet has a probation period! Collect entrance fees, deal with bizarre visitors, clean up disgusting messes, or just relax on the couch and let the chaos unfold. Will you become employee of the month or the laziest toilet attendant in town? It's your shift. Your rules.

apps.name: Shuriken Maestro
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you're a novice with the sword. Lucky for you, shurikens are more your specialty. Defeat enemies using your shurikens, hone your skills, upgrade your arsenal, and progress through increasingly challenging zones.

apps.name: Silent Orbits
apps.short_description: Explore a Fallout 2 inspired tactical grid map in this text-based sci-fi cRPG. You blacked out in 2089 and woke up 300 years later to a solar system reduced to ruins. Scavenge ships, craft items, and survive turn-based combat as narrative choices shape your journey.

apps.name: Silent Terminal
apps.short_description: A dark-fantasy RPG that lives entirely inside your terminal. Explore ASCII ruins, fight tactical turn-based battles, craft and grow your character, and make choices a persistent world never forgets. No textures. No filler. Just you, the numbers, and the dark.

apps.name: Skull Crusher
apps.short_description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

apps.name: SkyFab
apps.short_description: Stranded on a floating island in the shadow of a mysterious cube planet, you must survive using only your wits and advanced engineering. Build intricate automation lines, manage power grids, and transform a single tree into a sprawling industrial space station. Will you find your way home?

apps.name: Skyvar Idle
apps.short_description: An online idle RPG among floating sky islands. Sail your airship between the Sundered Isles, gather and craft while you're away, and let automated combat carry you through dungeons with friends. Build a guild island, trade in player-run halls and take down world bosses together.

apps.name: Slap Boxing Simulator
apps.short_description: Two fighters, eight maps, and a slap that gets heavier the longer you hold it. Slaps land where your hand really arrives. Bodies ragdoll when they drop. Built to be clipped.

apps.name: Slap the Curse
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

apps.name: Sleeping With the Sash
apps.short_description: Direct a live international beauty pageant on Colombia's Caribbean coast in this adult romance visual novel. Guide Octavio through three weeks of deadlines, backstage crises, and three distinct romance routes with Nayeli, Yamila, or Ondine.

apps.name: Snoutbreak
apps.short_description: First-person online horror for 1–6 players. Steal gold from a twisted fairy-tale dungeon, escape and compete to leave richer than your friends. If they die, rescue their talking heads. In Great Wolf mode, one of you hunts the others.

apps.name: Snow That Hums
apps.short_description: In a snow-covered industrial city, a man walks through empty streets filled with noise. He listens more than he looks. When a young woman interrupts his routine, the world begins to shift.

apps.name: Socks Pair Up
apps.short_description: Get a sock shop ready to open in this first-person sorting game. Match socks by color, pattern, and length, then stock shelves, boxes, clips, and mannequins. Earn rewards for displaying pairs and choose useful skills to make sorting easier, one pair at a time.

apps.name: SolTarot
apps.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores and bend the rules of solitaire. SolTarot is a tarot-inspired roguelike where you combine Tarot powers and modify your cards to overcome bosses that challenge your best combinations.

apps.name: Song Bao's Adventure
apps.short_description: Adapted from real lives. Song Bao leaves Shengdu on a scholarship to Lion City, where he learns the language, the rules, and the overtime — until lightning turns him into a chicken. A fully-voiced ink-wash interactive film: 40 scenes, 4 endings, told with a smile.

apps.name: Sortie
apps.short_description: Four friends. One very old plane. Fly it, find your way with a compass and a paper map, and climb out onto the wing to fix the engine in mid-air. Drop cargo, fight field fires, ride out storms and bird strikes, and try to land in one piece. Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: SOUL BACON
apps.short_description: SOULBACON is a 3D pig-based bullet heaven game with player guided world generation and snowballing builds. Kill baddies, farm missions and unlock an ever expanding frontier of unique upgrades, enemies, and replayable worlds.

apps.name: Soul Crypt
apps.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

apps.name: Spell Sniffers
apps.short_description: Spell Sniffers is a third-person social deduction action game for 1–8 players where goblins complete village tasks while hunting a hidden wizard. Work together, use proximity VOIP, spot sabotage, and survive to tell the tale.

apps.name: SpellWords
apps.short_description: SpellWords is a roguelike word-crafting game where every word casts a spell. Slide and swap letters to craft powerful word combinations, unleash game-changing spells, and build a strategy to score massive points.

apps.name: Spin It Lupin!
apps.short_description: Rotate four gems to form a matching 2×2 square! Clear all connected gems of the same color and trigger chain reactions as new gems fall. Enjoy 100 stages, high-score challenges, and local two-player versus and co-op modes.

apps.name: Star Catcher
apps.short_description: An atmospheric solo or co-op fishing adventure set across a sea of stars. Sail between ancient islands, catch lost souls, uncover forgotten lore, discover powerful relics, and unlock new regions as you draw closer to the truth of what lies beyond.

apps.name: STEEL GULLET
apps.short_description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

apps.name: Stellacore Defense
apps.short_description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

apps.name: Stellar Broadcast
apps.short_description: Guide humanity’s last colony ship through procedurally generated worlds, dangerous choices, alien encounters, and signal decoding puzzles. Manage dwindling systems, read each planet’s visual clues, and decide where civilization begins again or ends forever.

apps.name: Strike and Pop
apps.short_description:
Explosive arcade fighting game where you control a puppet with a balloon head.
Pop your rival's balloon using sharp weapons, play in duels or survival mode against the AI, unlock new weapons, and climb the online leaderboard!

apps.name: Super BallStorm
apps.short_description: Four fighters. One ball. Every hit makes it faster. Smash, block, dash and bend the ball with elemental powers until someone cracks. Super BallStorm is a local 4-player anime arena brawler built for couch chaos and split-second reads.

apps.name: Sword and Sweep
apps.short_description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

apps.name: Table of War
apps.short_description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

apps.name: Tank Dungeon
apps.short_description: Paint the arena and build your arsenal in a top-down action roguelite. Unlock vehicles, combine rockets, lasers and helper bots, and collect powerful equipment sets. Fight solo or in local co-op, then challenge friends in local or online territory-control skirmishes.

apps.name: Tanto
apps.short_description: You are stuck in seemingly endless rooms. Every step you take, every door you cross leave you in a room no different than the one before. Then you hear a little footstep - and you soon realize: you are not alone. Solve the puzzles and find your way out alive.

apps.name: Target One - Battle Royale
apps.short_description: A realistic battle royale for PC. Up to 126 players skydive onto one island, loot real guns and armour from towns, farms and an airfield, take a car and fight until the gas leaves room for only one. No respawns, no loot beams - everything you carry has to be earned.

apps.name: Task Bar Maid Cafe
apps.short_description: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.

apps.name: Taskforge
apps.short_description: Taskforge is an idle RPG that lives in a floating strip on your desktop. Pixel heroes fight on their own while you work — you gear them, pick the party, spend their talents and choose where to farm. 5 acts, 3 difficulties, pets to hatch and loot with six rarities, rolled affixes and sockets.

apps.name: TaskTown
apps.short_description:
Turn your everyday clicks and keystrokes into in-game currency! 
Collect cute and stylish animals, 
help them find their tools, and build a peaceful village of your own.

apps.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a traditional Turkish tea house with up to five friends online. Brew cay, grill toasties and race trays out to the shopkeepers next door. Keep the okey tables from turning into a brawl, take bets on match night, dodge the tea inspector and settle with the tax man - however you have to.

apps.name: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush
apps.short_description: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush is a community-made mod focused on restoring the atmosphere and presentation the game had in its earlier years.

apps.name: The Advent: Children of Arla
apps.short_description: Uncover the secrets of Argus, a planet shaped by ancient beings for humanity's future. Solve puzzles, battle foes, and explore lore-rich worlds inspired by Mesoamerican mythology in this hybrid MMORPG.

apps.name: The Cardian - Light the Shrines
apps.short_description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

apps.name: The Castle of the West
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, fantasy-themed boomer shooter inspired by the greats. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand crafted non-linear fps stages. What's not to love?

apps.name: The drawing of the Exodus
apps.short_description:
This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible,
told using images generated by artificial intelligence
and accompanied by brief captions.

apps.name: The Hollow Servant
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of writer Robert Baum in a quiet Arkansas town where something is deeply wrong. Explore a haunted home, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover a disturbing supernatural mystery in this first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: The Horde of Gorak
apps.short_description: Lead a growing orc horde in this pixel art incremental strategy game. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief

apps.name: The Inverted Spire
apps.short_description:
Goblin mages dungeon-crawl to redemption in this dark fantasy negotiation RPG. Guide your
expedition of outcasts through a deadly architectural marvel stretching deep below the
earth. Read minds. Form alliances. Break them. Anything is possible in the uncharted depths of the Inverted Spire

apps.name: The Kingdom's Merchant
apps.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

apps.name: The Last Code
apps.short_description: Jump, shoot, dodge and manipulate the world with magnetic forces. Battle robots, navigate deadly traps and solve physics-based puzzles on a fallen space station where an autonomous AI may be humanity's last hope.

apps.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!
apps.short_description: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!

apps.name: The Mire of Miss Audacity
apps.short_description:
After waking up in a world without her sister, Miss Alexandra Audacity believes she's been left out of a conspiracy between her flaky friends and secretive husband. 

Guide her through five timelines mired by false memories while trying to keep her sanity, and yours.

apps.name: The Peg Mines
apps.short_description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

apps.name: The Prison Incident
apps.short_description: Reconstruct a fatal prison riot by reverse-engineering deleted terminal logs and determine how each person involved in The Prison Incident meets their end.

apps.name: The Publisher’s Magic Bookshop
apps.short_description: Build and run a cozy bookshop: decorate your space, stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers. Write and publish your own books, discover stories from other players, and grow a shop where every shelf has a story.

apps.name: Theorem Cards
apps.short_description: Prove theorems by playing cards, just like in a game of solitaire. Your solution is checked by a real theorem prover. Sharpen your math skills by solving thousands of puzzles across six difficulty levels.

apps.name: Thousand Wheels
apps.short_description: Investigate murders across parallel universes in a hand-drawn detective puzzle game inspired by Ottoman medieval art. Gather clues, identify suspects, and reconstruct events to uncover a mystery spanning multiple realities.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
apps.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

apps.name: Throneforged
apps.short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists.  Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

apps.name: Thumb Hiker
apps.short_description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

apps.name: Tiny Trouble
apps.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

apps.name: Tokyo Honey Trap for Beginners
apps.short_description: Lead Japan’s first external intelligence training course in eighty years as Naoki Tsukuda, an honest ex-consular officer learning the art of deception. Choose one of three complete romance routes where duty, grief, trust, and desire collide.

apps.name: Topiary: A Pruning Puzzle
apps.short_description: Grow trees into beautiful shapes in Topiary, a peaceful puzzle game about pruning and planning ahead. Cutting a branch doesn't just remove it, it changes where your tree grows next. Take your time with each puzzle, or challenge yourself to make every season count.

apps.name: Tour - Chess Puzzles
apps.short_description: Visit all the light squares exactly once to solve the puzzles in this game. Inspired by the classic Knight's Tour challenge, but taken to new levels with a wide variety of special tiles and pieces.

apps.name: TPS Tickman: Castle Defense
apps.short_description: Hold the canyon wall against 30 waves of stickmen in a laid-back third-person shooter. Arm your castle with auto turrets, missiles, drones and cavalry, hijack enemy tanks, fly a gunship, and bring down six giant bosses. No grind, no difficulty levels — just shoot.

apps.name: Trauma Room
apps.short_description:
Get ready for the most ridiculous (but also realistic) problems you can run into at the vet clinic. Today is the perfect day to help our furry and aquatic pals!
And best of all, you can treat them all together with your friends in online co-op!

apps.name: True Feelings Plus
apps.short_description: In this NTR visual novel, play as Touya, whose new crush Akari catches your coworker’s eye. As your relationship grows, a confident rival competes for her attention. Will you protect Akari from getting seduced by another man, or quietly let it happen? Experience the story from multiple perspectives!

apps.name: Turd: Combat Devolved
apps.short_description: Turd: Combat Devolved is the ultimate turd-person shooter! Battle endless waves of crap or fight friends in PvP. Master poop chemistry by balancing constipation, mud butt, and diarrhea. Manage your fecal mass carefully—your health is also your ammo! Dominate the underground and be peak turd.

apps.name: Turning Manor
apps.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

apps.name: TV Station Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

apps.name: TwitchyKitchen
apps.short_description: EVERYONE'S LOSING IT! Cook, serve and rebuild your restaurant while chefs and customers alike have uncontrollable outbursts. Up to 4 players, local or online. Full Twitch Meter? Your chef throws, spins or sprints off. Turn chaos into combos and don't give a damn what the angry customers think.

apps.name: UKNON Jones - Fighters
apps.short_description:
A spin-off of the series: "UKNON Jones & Guynelk" and developed by one person.
A colorful, dynamic 2.D fighting game playable locally or online with characters possessing unique and varied abilities.

apps.name: UNDERDEEP
apps.short_description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

apps.name: UNSEAM
apps.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

apps.name: Untitled Maze Game
apps.short_description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird   this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

apps.name: Vegetableau
apps.short_description: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game.  Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty.  Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.

apps.name: VESSOUL
apps.short_description: Control an animate vessel powered by motes of light; Explore a world laden with shadows, spirits, forgotten graves, and charred ruins to discover the truth of its past. Escape the cycle, and achieve Ascension, or be bound to eternal servitude for all time. The fate of the Innerlands lies with you...

apps.name: Vestige Idle
apps.short_description: Kill monsters, get loot & level up - a fantasy ARPG in Idle form. Build your character by obtaining powerful and unique items from enemies, leveling up to gain Skill Points used across multiple trees and progressively unlocking major systems like The Forge, The Guild, The Market and more...

apps.name: Waiting for Heaven
apps.short_description: Waiting for Heaven is a psychological first-person-horror experience about waiting at a lonely bus stop between life and death. Every decision counts. Your actions, patience, and behavior determine whether the final bus takes you to Heaven, Hell, or somewhere far worse.

apps.name: Walter?
apps.short_description: Help a mysterious she-wolf, summoned from the world of the dead, return to her eternal rest. Destroy figures from literature and folklore in turn-based combat through a simple yet brutal memory game.

apps.name: Warlock: Age of Entropy
apps.short_description: A power-hungry warlock descends fifteen floors to unearth a malevolent energy sealed deep in a dungeon. He'll have to use items sparingly, spells tactically, and even recruit the help of forgotten gods to get there in this brutally difficult traditional roguelike.

apps.name: WASH WASH!
apps.short_description: From cars to trains and massive ships! Clean it yourself, automate, and grow your own cleaning company!

apps.name: Water Maid
apps.short_description: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

apps.name: WattWorks
apps.short_description: WattWorks a chill Idle game where can build and expand your power grid. You play as the manager controlling your company by building power generators and expanding your company in your small world. To Expand further you have to sell your company and rebuild a stronger company

apps.name: We Are Rebellion
apps.short_description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

apps.name: When Wolf Fades
apps.short_description: A pulp crime drama where you are The Big Bad Wolf, the underworld boss of Dark City. Every kind of illegal activity, two decks of psychos, six rivals, and one month to survive await you. Run your empire and keep your true identity hidden.

apps.name: Where Control Ends
apps.short_description: Where Control Ends is a psychological visual novel about Astra, a young girl trying to hold herself together after a night she cannot fully remember.

apps.name: Whisper of the Divine
apps.short_description: Whisper of the Divine is a god-game where your main tool is your own voice. Type in your own words to your Demi-God and hope to be mostly understood. Villagers have a will of their own and can say no, raiders can be talked down, and there is no game-over.

apps.name: Wilderune
apps.short_description: Explore a voxel world across seven biomes, face towering guardians and find your style among 49 weapons. Craft equipment, combine movement accessories and tame animal companions in Wilderune, an action RPG built around exploration.

apps.name: Wildfire Command '98
apps.short_description:
The year is 1998 and you're the Air Attack Supervisor. Read the wind, the slope and the fuel, then
draw the lines your tankers and helicopters will fly. Ten authored fires, endless generated
incidents, two-player co-op, and a shareable replay of every run.

apps.name: Wildsunder
apps.short_description: Hunt fearsome creatures in a stylized coastal wilderness. Wildsunder is a third-person action RPG built around weighty weapon combat, dangerous encounters, and a hunter's life beyond the safety of Saltroot Refuge.

apps.name: Wonderful Neoran Valley
apps.short_description: A monster-collector roguelite where the next 7 turns are yours to plan.

apps.name: X-Dolls Squad
apps.short_description: Fight through intense FPS operations alongside the X-Dolls. Complete objectives, upgrade your weapons and abilities, hunt secrets, eliminate powerful bosses, and survive a campaign across hostile locations filled with supernatural threats and deadly enemies.

apps.name: XPELLIT Survivors
apps.short_description: A story-driven anime survivors-like. Samara wakes up with no memories in the Eternal Forest: carve through hordes with evolving Xpells, live through events and missions that change every run, and face Mirelle in a cinematic three-phase final battle.

apps.name: XXL 猛漢町
apps.short_description: Welcome to WOOFIA, a land where humans, Beastfolks, and Hominians of all kinds thrive in vibrant harmony. Join our protagonist in this diverse world as he embarks on an adventurous journey, meeting all kinds of unique men and igniting fiery passions along the way!

apps.name: Yakko Tako
apps.short_description:
Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly,
tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky.
One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

apps.name: Your account has been suspended
apps.short_description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

apps.name: Your place
apps.short_description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

apps.name: yttrium X
apps.short_description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

apps.name: Z-Colony
apps.short_description: Build, manage, and defend a survivor colony in a zombie-infested world. Gather resources, craft, hunt,treat injuries and expand your base while facing a constant threat against zombies, bandits, wildlife and more to come in a harsh player controlled post-apocalyptic survival.

apps.name: Zero Mass
apps.short_description: Carve through asteroids, haul valuable ore, and upgrade your mining ship in ZERO MASS, a single player space mining game. Take on contracts, deploy drones and drilling rigs, uncover buried artifacts, and tackle dangerous encounters across procedural asteroid fields.

apps.name: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
apps.short_description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

apps.name: 【第七格位】
apps.short_description: "The Seventh Slot" is a narrative-driven game set in a modern Japanese city, blending visual novel elements with the exploration of inner worlds and combat.

apps.name: かくれ鬼: Hide-and-Seek Horror
apps.short_description:
This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game.
Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight.
With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness. Experience the thrill of a deadly hunt.

apps.name: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー
丹道登仙：炼丹师模拟器
apps.short_description: Live the true life of a xianxia alchemist. No set recipes: master herb lore to devise divine pills. Farm seasonal spirit fields, trade in lively markets, and bid at auctions. Shape mortal fates, take disciples, bond with Dao companions, brave the lightning tribulation, and ascend through alchemy!

apps.name: 偶像星域
apps.short_description: Idol Lust is an idle strategy game combining strategy and RPG. As the manager of agency "LUCKY", you willl guide idols on stage and lead them to fight "U-Mutations" to protect New Tokyo!

apps.name: 宇宙創世記カグラ ～素粒子協奏曲～
apps.short_description: Perform with gods or another player in a three-button rhythm game. Play solo alongside four gods or create a room for an online duet. Hit in harmony to collect particles and build atoms, stars, planets and life. Enjoy music and discover cosmic creation across generations.

apps.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
apps.short_description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

apps.name: 桃园幸存者：匡扶汉室
apps.short_description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

apps.name: 榜一请报案
apps.short_description:
《榜一请报案》是一款以华国江临市为背景的都市恋爱轻悬疑互动影游。你将扮演独立游戏程序员林越，从深夜直播间里的一次礼物开始，结识女主播苏小晚。一次地铁上的意外，让你们共同走进派出所，也让你遇见一位清冷的女警。随着事件推进，你将在情感与真相之间不断做出选择。每一次选择，都可能改变关系走向，甚至提前抵达不同结局。

故事发生在直播间、咖啡馆、地铁车厢、派出所、火锅店、漫展、江边与废弃车站等都市场景中。你会从虚拟礼物走进现实情感，也会在轻悬疑事件中面对信任、保护与抉择。

apps.name: 火柴：异世开拓记
apps.short_description: Build a fantasy town and send a party of up to four adventurers on automatic expeditions. Recruit five classes, develop skill trees, collect randomized loot and legendary sets, then push through four regions, Nightmare challenges and an endless rift while your town keeps earning offline.

apps.name: 狐ト蛙ノ旅
apps.short_description:
"Where will their light lead them?" 
Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

apps.name: 王之将死/Checkmate
apps.short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

apps.name: 科伊的逃亡
apps.short_description: 《科伊的逃亡》是一款2D回合制Roguelike卡牌游戏。带领三位命运交织的主角——科伊、莱斯莉与希娜，在崩坏的世界中搜集线索、构筑卡组、破解谜题，揭开末日背后的真相。200+张卡牌，无限可能的策略组合，每一次逃亡都是全新的故事。

apps.name: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
apps.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

apps.name: 隐藏真探
apps.short_description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

apps.name: 霞客行 Cloudfarer
apps.short_description: Cloudfarer is a desktop idle wuxia RPG. Send your party traveling, collect gear and build their decks. Play turn-based card battles yourself or enable auto route and auto battle for a run. Grow flowers, collect curios and arrange your finds on your desktop.

apps.name: 온에어, 온기
apps.short_description: Take charge of a small radio station as its new producer. Plan broadcasts, manage your crew, negotiate ad contracts, and connect with listeners over 365 days. Every decision shapes your station's future—and how its story ends.
